notes: Full audit of ALL divide-related backward pass ops. 4 bugs found and fixed: (1) divide_bp: NDArray view corruption (NDArray negX(*x) shares buffer, applyTransform(Neg) corrupts input) + evalBroadcastBackwardAxis using epsNext shape instead of pre-gradient shape. (2) realdiv_bp: same axis bug + memory leaks (preX, preY, sum never freed). (3) reversedivide_bp: same axis bug (epsNext->shapeInfo() instead of preXTemp/preY shapes). (4) floormod_bp: NDArray temp(*epsNext) view corruption + missing delete. Safe ops: floordiv_bp (assigns zero), divide_no_nan (no C++ bp), xdivy (no bp), truncatediv (no bp). Also checked add_bp, subtract_bp, reverse_subtract_bp, squared_subtract_bp — all safe (pre-gradient is epsNext itself, or tiled to epsNext shape). Two CPU rebuilds completed. Gradient verification: divide 40/40 pass, reversedivide 40/40 pass, divideNoNan 1/1 pass.
